data.name: Mix It up
data.detailed_description:
🍸 Mix It Up🍹

Welcome to Mix It Up — the fast-paced social bartending game where players learn real cocktail and mocktail recipes while competing against time and friends in a lively multiplayer bar experience. Step behind the counter, serve demanding customers, and master authentic drinks inspired by recipes from cultures and regions around the world. From Mojitos and Bloody Marys to creative mocktails and speciality mixes, every drink is crafted through interactive step-by-step gameplay designed to be both fun and educational.

Mix Drink Games (Mix it up ) is a social bartending game where players create cocktails and mocktails in fun, stylised bar environments. Step behind the counter as a cheerful bean-shaped bartender, mix drinks with friends or other players, and serve a lively crowd of colourful customers from around the world.

Master recipes step by step, balance sweetness, bitterness, strength, and presentation, and learn how real drinks are made in a playful, game-like way. Whether you are preparing a classic cocktail, experimenting with themed festival drinks, or competing to serve customers faster and better than everyone else, every round is about timing, accuracy, and style.

Play in social settings inspired by beach bars, tiki bars, neon lounges, festivals, and more. Customise your mascot, unlock outfits and themed venues, and build your reputation as the ultimate party bartender. Designed for replayability, Mix Drink Game blends light education, social fun, and competitive multiplayer into an energetic bar experience.

Features

  • Multiplayer bartending gameplay in lively social venues

  • Make cocktails and mocktails step by step

  • Learn recipes, tools, ingredients, and drink presentation

  • Serve expressive customers with different preferences

  • Compete, cooperate, and climb the rankings

  • Customise your mascot with outfits and style variations

  • Explore themed bar environments and cultural drink inspirations

  • Planned expansion with many more drinks, modes, and social features

Whether you want to chill with friends, improve your mixology knowledge, or enjoy a colourful party game, Mix Drink Game is all about mixing it up.

🍸 Mix It Up – Official Teaser Trailer released 24 May 2026 🍹

Features:

• Learn real cocktail & mocktail recipes

• Fast-paced single-player challenge mode

• Competitive multiplayer mixology battles

• Unlock drinks, cosmetics, and achievements

• Level up your bartender and customise your character

• Earn virtual currency through gameplay progression

• Social and community-driven gameplay experiences

Unlike traditional cooking or restaurant games, Mix It Up combines practical mixology knowledge with arcade-style gameplay, allowing players to genuinely learn drink-making techniques while enjoying a chaotic and entertaining social experience. We’re also building a growing community around seasonal events, multiplayer challenges, and future sponsorship collaborations inspired by real-world beverage brands and energy drink culture.

🍹 Wishlist Mix It Up on Steam

📱 Coming to PC & Mobile

🔥 Join the community and become the ultimate bartender

data.short_description: Run your own Mix Drinks bar in single-player, learn real recipes step by step, and serve customers against the clock in Easy, Medium, and Hard modes. Master recipes, unlock new drinks, and sharpen your bartending skills before taking the party online in multiplayer with friends.

Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required. Controller support optional.
